by occupation who is the resident of\u0026nbsp; nalgonda\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; presented with pedal edema since 1 month and sob since yesterday\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1 month back later he developed pedal edema Which was gradual in onset\u0026nbsp; progressed to knee , associated with facial puffiness then he went to chityala and he has taken the medications which was prescribed by local doctor ,symptoms got relieved.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Then yesterday night he developed pedal edema associated\u0026nbsp; sob which was sudden in onset\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo aggrevating and relieving factors\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFor which his wife fed 1 bread and milk and later he vomited.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o chestpain\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o palpitations\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast h\/o :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo similar complaints in past\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EN\/k\/c\/o DM , HTN ,ASTHMA ,CAD, EPILEPSY,TB\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal h\/o :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Esleep adequate\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet mixed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDecreased urine output since morning\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAddictions :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient started consuming alcohol since 17 yrs ( unadulterated tody and whiskey 180ml once in 15 days gradually increased to 360ml of whiskey in the span of 10 yrs)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFrom past 5- 6 years he developed binge drinking pattern and would drink on days he had money . He used to drink for 3- 4 days continuously and he don't drink for the\u0026nbsp; next 15 days and his last drink was on 12th oct ( 750ml whiskey)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o of tobacco chewing ( 1 packet \/ day ) since 17 yrs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn examination -\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt was unresponsive with frothing with spo2 48%\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;In view of falling saturation , patient was intubated with ET 7 , Inj Midazolam 2cc\/w\/stat , Inj glycopycolate 2cc\/ stat\u0026nbsp; with inj NORAD - DS @6ml\/hr\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EStarted on Inj Dobutamine @1ml\/hr\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo pallor ,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo icterus ,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo cyanosis ,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo clubbing,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBilateral pitting type of pedal edema is present upto knee\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHis vitals :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfebrile to touch\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBp - not recordable ( at 3: 30 am)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBp at 4:00am - 60\/40 mmhg\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPulse - feeble\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERR - 30cpm\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESpo2 - 48% at room air\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGRBS - 148mg%\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESystemic :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EP\/A :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EShape of abdomen : obese\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Eno scars , sinuses ,no distended veins ,hernial orifices free ,soft\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo tenderness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERS : BAE + Nvbs heard\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo added sounds\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECNS : NAD\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECVS\u0026nbsp;
